label: accepted

evidence.V1: Base-shaft-capital column silhouette reads clearly in front, three-quarter and silhouette; top view is a clean square abacus.
evidence.V2: Big shaft, medium plinth/torus/abacus, small gold necking band and flutes; clear hierarchy.
evidence.V3: Proportions are classical but straight: no entasis, capital is a thin slab sitting directly on the band (minimal echinus), so it reads a little stiff.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers on plinth, torus and abacus catch light in base and capital close-ups.
evidence.V5: Shaft shows wavy vertical streaks in studio light (front view and shaft close-up) and flutes are barely visible as geometry; minor smoothing artifact.
evidence.V6: Stone hue in 3 values (dark plinth/abacus, light shaft) plus one gold accent; disciplined in brick and sandstone colourways.
evidence.V8: One vertex-colour material, ~0.06 stud chamfers, gold band accent, stone values; matches the kit.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct (Anchored, CollisionFidelity Box, CanTouch off, Color white, SmoothPlastic); seats shaft_on_base and capital_on_shaft seated; A15 symmetry 0.0; T1 vertical tiling pass.

artifacts: wavy vertical shading streaks along the shaft; flutes too shallow to read
top_fixes: Deepen the shaft flutes (or remove them) and fix shaft normals so the wavy streaks go away
Add an echinus/cushion between the gold band and the abacus and a slight entasis taper for a more confident stylised column
Thicken the abacus slightly so the capital balances the plinth
